name: Statement & Conclusion
shortcutSummary: A conclusion must logically follow from the statement without adding outside knowledge. If it requires an assumption not in the statement, it does not follow.
conceptExplanation: Statement and Conclusion questions present a statement followed by two conclusions. You must determine which conclusion(s) logically follow from the statement alone — not from general knowledge or common sense.

subtopics.name: Statement & Conclusion — Core Concepts
subtopics.explanation: Statement and Conclusion questions present a statement followed by two conclusions. You must determine which conclusion(s) logically follow from the statement alone — not from general knowledge or common sense.
shortcuts: Strict Logic Rule: Only what is stated or directly implied counts — no outside knowledge.
Both/Neither Check: Always consider that both, one, or neither conclusion may follow.
Keyword Attention: Words like "all", "some", "only", "always", "never" critically change what follows.
